_note: Español de España; see topbar.json. The Edit view as home.rs draws it: the empty Props view, the Objects list, the status line (An and Al for width and height), the canvas's menu, the object tools, the theme and stage titles and tools, the lists of songs, slides and props and their keys, the Edit Words window, and why a key is greyed. Rows of lang-tables.js of the design were used where they exist (Fit, Lock, Copy style, Paste style, Web Page, NDI Source, Add ▾, Duplicate, Delete, Move up, Move down).
